body.label: Effect
body.html: Burn 1 additional Action Die before rolling. On success, deal 1 Necrotic Damage and impose -1 on its next Success Die until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: On a hit, move 1 unit away from the target.

rider.title: Rite - Offering
rider.html: Rite, 1 Echo: on a hit, the target becomes Possessed. Trigger: it misses an Action. Echo: it is Slowed 2 until your next turn.
